root.label: Colin Martinez dies after fraternity hazing

events.label: Colin Martinez dies after fraternity hazing

slots.name: blood alcohol
slots.sentence: The autopsy found acute ethanol toxicity was Martinez's cause of death and classified it as accidental.

slots.name: chapter status
slots.sentence: The Delta Tau Delta chapter at Northern Arizona University closed following Martinez's death.

slots.name: initial arrests
slots.sentence: They were released after police did not submit criminal charges to prosecutors at the time.

slots.name: vodka amount
slots.sentence: According to the Arizona Republic, the pledges were given a 1.75-liter bottle of vodka and told to finish it among themselves.

slots.name: pledge count
slots.sentence: Martinez was an 18-year-old student and one of four pledges seeking to join Delta Tau Delta at NAU.

slots.name: death date
slots.sentence: Martinez died Jan. 31 at an off-campus house near Northern Arizona University in Flagstaff, Arizona.

slots.name: blood alcohol concentration
slots.sentence: An autopsy determined he died from acute ethanol toxicity and found that his blood-alcohol concentration was 0.425%.

slots.name: arrest count
slots.sentence: Three 20-year-old fraternity executive board members, including Eslick, were initially arrested after Martinez's death.

slots.name: charge date
slots.sentence: The Coconino County Attorney's Office ultimately brought the felony hazing case against Eslick.
